inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Requirements, users, tasks, states, and acceptance criteria

inputs.name: projectContext
inputs.description: Real-product business context, source-of-truth boundary, and frozen frontendFoundation contract

when: A requirement must become a tested runnable page
The target maps to registered kit patterns and components
stopWhen: Business context or acceptance criteria are incomplete
Input validation, build, interaction, visual, or bundle gates fail

target.label: TianShu operations workspace
target.description: Runnable 16-page Ant Design product workspace generated and accepted from the canonical requirement-to-final-page path.

acceptanceGates.criteria: Generation validates the selected output mode, framework, exact foundation package and version, design pack hash, import roots, and acceptance adapters before writing
acceptanceGates.command: npm run validate:foundations && npm run test:project-generator && npm run check:harness:import-profiles

acceptanceGates.criteria: Explicit valid input generates deterministic code and invalid input writes nothing
New projects bind stable demonstration objects through sample-pack, resolve every page data requirement, and generate pages from one read-only sample-data module
acceptanceGates.command: npm run validate:sample-pack && npm run test:project-generator

acceptanceGates.criteria: Only approved flow contracts run; a real browser preserves stable object IDs across at least two pages and proves an observable state change, result destination, and recovery path

Qualifying blind candidates bind canonical run identity, product-only receipts, permanent external seals, evaluator revisions, raw execution output, stable step and interaction IDs, runner-owned runtime observations, screenshots, and final evidence; missing preview and preview readiness failures also preserve canonical failed evidence while all 16 negative categories fail closed

Fresh v1.2.2 attempts bind committed pre-reveal and immutable input receipt bytes to the active registry record; replacement identities, input, assignment, workspace, source, and dist stay fresh; the initial-freeze command validates its implementation closure, all six explicit contract paths, non-empty build and preview scripts, route, receipt absence, and claim availability before synchronously rechecking the snapshot and reserving a permanent claim

The independent 5-run KPI has one registry owner; every future slot freezes commits, protocol hashes, package bytes, arm isolation, anonymous assignment, metrics, and an unopened input receipt before PRD disclosure

A post-score drift observation may add only the optional intentCard.viewDecision primary, supporting, and rationale fields; malformed or self-conflicting decisions fail closed without migrating existing pages
Lab and TianShu pages each execute a key interaction while technical and visual verdicts remain independently recorded
acceptanceGates.command: npm run validate:page-acceptance && npm run validate:page-acceptance:lab

acceptanceGates.criteria: Existing projects, harness contracts, DOM contracts, and bundles stay within their fixed gates

A deterministic tarball installs into an isolated strict NodeNext consumer, exposes the public API, excludes private runtime-control files, and runs the packaged harness and generator across working directories

externalDependencies.fallback: Fail before writing when a pattern or component is not registered

completion.summary: The three-mode foundation contract, deterministic multi-framework generator, mode-aware import policy, split technical and visual ledgers, sample-pack continuity, approved cross-page flow acceptance, and blind protocol v1.2/v1.2.1/v1.2.2 gates are implemented. The registry preserves eight historical attempts: three qualifying and five invalidated. Their raw kitFirstPass values remain frozen. Stage diagnostics classify the current KPI assessment as indeterminate-current-harness. The 18-cell non-scoring synthetic readiness matrix and C5 independent review are complete. One authorized guided pilot with a consumed historical PRD produced honest typecheck, build, preview, flow, shutdown, source, and dist evidence; it remains NO-GO because its generation attempt lacked a system-enforced workspace read boundary.
remaining: Close the guided-pilot generation workspace-read isolation P1, then rerun with fresh run, artifact, workspace, source, dist, and evidence identities while keeping the final eligible PRD untouched
Preserve frozen protocol thresholds and historical raw evidence while keeping attribution at indeterminate-current-harness
Apply the frozen viewDecision only when a new page has a real priority decision and retain its runtime negative examples
Keep generation-trace.json, page-context, the 39 component-field rewrite, full Block IDs, and the existing 32-page migration deferred until their triggers occur

The fixed full-image and critical-region thresholds are enforced and the post-publish root-node stability diff passes

Post-publish readback verified 66 CURRENT variables, 11 valid semantic aliases, 23 bound Paint Styles, seven CURRENT component objects with preserved keys and eight page-template frames. Root node 19154:402 remains byte-identical across two saved captures and passes the fixed-threshold stability diff. Stable capture ID 91041828-759e-45b9-b322-607109106a3a registered the accepted vulnerability-platform browser page and produced reference node 19215:401. The separate browser-to-raw-capture diagnostic remains a recorded non-gating failure; the authoritative component target and its acceptance diff are unchanged.

workflows.title: Routed page with optional exploratory Image2

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Product requirements and exact UI content

inputs.name: fileKey
inputs.description: Real Figma destination for live stages

when: A page request explicitly selects a strategy-bound existing or exploratory route
General B2B work defaults to the existing direct route; high-variance visual exploration requires explicit opt-in
stopWhen: designContext or its strategy-bound route decision is missing, unknown, or inconsistent
Existing work contains Image2 inputs, or exploratory work lacks a frozen visual brief, structured contract, or real component foundation

target.label: Image2 Golden 3 RBAC forbidden page
target.description: Golden 3 v1 remains the last accepted runnable Image2 page. General B2B generation now defaults to the existing direct route without Image2. Exploratory Image2 requires explicit high-variance visual goals and a frozen visual brief. Restart-5 is paused-by-strategy-review at 0/2; historical candidates and verdicts remain sealed, and Figma YOUR_NODE_ID remains locked.

blockedDelivery.reason: The strategy amendment pauses restart-5 execution while preserving its 0/2 budget and all historical authorization, receipt, evidence, and verdict bytes. No fresh input is requested. Image2 generation, reference generation, candidate generation, reviewers, fresh private input reads, Figma YOUR_NODE_ID, and push remain locked.
resumeRequirements: Use the existing direct route for general B2B pages
Select exploratory only for explicit composition, atmosphere, material, brand, or visual-direction work with a frozen visual brief
Require a new append-only strategy decision before restart-5 execution or any locked Image2 stage resumes
Keep Figma target node YOUR_NODE_ID untouched until a separate authorization explicitly releases it

acceptanceGates.criteria: Both routes, freeze gates, shared stages, and stop conditions validate and package

The runner fixtures prove fixed global and critical-region RMS, SSIM, changed-pixel, and dimension gates; each real pair keeps its raw verdict while any semantic exception and independent calibration label are recorded separately
Every batch pair binds exact images, fixed raw thresholds, clean Browser and Playwright evidence, two isolated reviews, a fail-closed qualified/disputed decision, and non-inflated study accounting
acceptanceGates.command: npm run test:image2-calibration && npm run validate:image2-calibration

acceptanceGates.criteria: The 5/24 plus one disputed study remains frozen, the remaining 19-pair expansion stays paused, the active gate is three Golden Pages plus two holdouts within 13 iterations, and any new batch fails without a new explicit authorization record

The six-candidate pool, mutually exclusive Golden and Holdout assignments, exact input receipts, sealed implementation roots, one-shot Holdout policy, two-reviewer unanimity, and 13-iteration budget fail closed before Golden 2 starts

The formal AntD generator emits the content-schedule Golden Page deterministically, rejects invalid operational contracts, typechecks, builds, preserves existing fixture hashes, and passes responsive plus interaction acceptance without console errors
acceptanceGates.command: npm run test:project-generator && npm run typecheck && npm run antd:lint:projects && npm run build --prefix preview

acceptanceGates.criteria: The formal AntD generator emits the reports-logs Golden Page deterministically, rejects invalid analytics contracts, preserves existing fixture hashes, typechecks, builds, passes three responsive viewports and refresh/export interactions without console errors, and receives two independent PASS reviews before user acceptance

The formal AntD generator emits the RBAC forbidden Golden Page deterministically, rejects invalid permission-state contracts, preserves existing fixture hashes, typechecks, builds, exposes no protected tables, passes three responsive viewports plus request/recovery/focus/mobile interactions, and keeps the final browser console free of errors and warnings

The old NO-GO stays immutable, Radio coverage is isolated to a non-Holdout fixture, two fresh mutually exclusive identities and both deterministic output bundles freeze before inspection, the 13-iteration budget stays exact, and a required Holdout failure records NO-GO before raw diff, reviewers, or Figma

The prior NO-GO remains immutable, generic filter remediation is confined to a new non-Holdout canary, two implementation-unseen source variants reserve iterations 9 and 10, one-shot reference generation waits for prompt confirmation, and Figma remains locked

The opt-in list-filter contract is isolated to a non-Holdout canary, rejects six invalid mapping cases, generates deterministically, typechecks, filters and resets the visible business state in a clean browser, preserves every pre-existing fixture bundle, records the known worktree-only full-validation path failure without bypass, consumes no visible iteration, and keeps both Holdouts plus Figma sealed

User confirmation binds exactly two pre-frozen prompts; each candidate receives one and only one host-generated reference without prior candidate inspection, retry, multi-result selection, calibration expansion, iteration consumption, or Figma access; prompt, image, metadata, dimensions, and predecessor receipts fail closed

Both one-page descriptions remain canonical copies of the mutually exclusive frozen source pages, both library-native React AntD 6.5.0 contexts and preview inputs bind exact receipts, all generator dependencies freeze before either output exists, prior Holdout outputs remain excluded, and iterations 9 and 10 plus the Figma lock fail closed

Iterations 9 and 10 each run the formal generator exactly twice from the committed derived inputs, all four runs exit zero, both three-file bundles are byte-identical, exact output and raw-run receipts freeze before any semantic or rendered inspection, no retry or result selection is allowed, and the 10/13 budget plus Figma lock fail closed

The frozen outputs remain immutable; overview typecheck and zero-issue AntD CLI lint are preserved; a required build command MODULE_NOT_FOUND failure closes the one-shot evaluation as NO-GO without claiming a candidate implementation defect, retrying the runner, starting the other candidate's technical gates, opening Browser or visual review, spending beyond 10/13, or entering Figma; targeted validators pass and the separate repository-wide blind N15 preview-readiness failure remains raw and unbypassed

The user-authorized non-Holdout evaluator repair preserves the prior NO-GO, both unchanged frozen candidates pass typecheck, zero-issue AntD CLI lint, and write-disabled Vite build, and Overview's first Browser assertion failure closes the replay before Detail, responsive capture, raw diff, reviewers, or Figma. The replay consumes no implementation iteration, all candidate/reference receipts remain exact, the initial missing Playwright executable and the worktree-wide guided-pilot canonical-path failure remain raw, and no bypass or rerun is allowed

Two new mutually exclusive identities and both one-shot references freeze before implementation. Non-Holdout preflight passes without changing its existing dist. Candidate A runs the formal generator once and freezes a four-file receipt before inspection. Its library-native import boundary passes, then the generation-knowledge gate stops because the pre-inspection evaluator plan overconstrains Select even though the frozen source has one text filter and no select field. The NO-GO does not claim a candidate defect, forbids repair or replay, leaves Candidate B ungenerated, consumes only iteration 11, and keeps every browser, visual, reviewer, and Figma gate closed. The single repository-wide validation preserves the existing guided-pilot canonical-path failure after blind N15 passes.

Iteration 13 preserves the one-shot reference and sealed candidate, records the 390x844 browser overflow failure at 161px against the frozen 0px maximum, stops before raw diff, reviewers, user final review, or Figma, closes the budget at 13/13, and keeps every historical NO-GO immutable. The successor catalog adjudication preserves that closeout while validating its old catalog receipt from the original commit and delegating the live catalog to validate:foundations.

A separate synthetic seven-column AntD filtering fixture reproduces the mobile page overflow without reading or changing any Holdout, then the conditional generator repair produces zero page-level overflow at 390, 1024, and 1440 widths, keeps wide-table scrolling inside the table, preserves filter and reset behavior, rejects five output mutations, and leaves the existing four-column fixture byte-identical. The successor receipt keeps the historical form-content implementation exact at its source commit, binds the live generator infrastructure to the responsive remediation commit, and records a repository-wide validation pass.

Restart-5 uses a separate 0/2 candidate-generation budget, requires two fresh mutually exclusive identities, permits one confirmed reference and one sealed candidate generation per Holdout, keeps the historical 13/13 and 0/2 result immutable, retains the frozen content, browser, raw-diff, two-reviewer, and user-final gates, and keeps Figma YOUR_NODE_ID locked until a separate post-2/2 authorization.

General B2B defaults to the existing direct route without Image2, exploratory stays opt-in and visual-only with a frozen brief, restart-5 remains paused at 0/2, and every current generation, Reviewer, private-input, Figma, and push lock stays closed
The live destination, viewport, receipts, write subtree, namespaced asset exception, and publish deny boundary remain machine-verifiable

externalDependencies.fallback: Use only for an explicitly selected exploratory route after its frozen visual brief passes
Keep the isolated target and deny boundaries; do not write while the raw visual and calibration gates remain closed

completion.summary: The append-only strategy amendment makes existing the default route for general B2B pages and removes Image2 plus Image-to-html from that direct pipeline. Exploratory keeps Image2 only for explicit composition, atmosphere, material, brand, or visual-direction work; structured contracts and real components retain authority over copy, data, interaction, states, responsive behavior, and accessibility. Restart-5 is paused-by-strategy-review at 0/2. All historical Image2 evidence and verdicts remain frozen, and every generation, Reviewer, private-input, Figma YOUR_NODE_ID, and push lock remains closed.
remaining: Apply the existing direct route to general B2B page work
Require an explicit exploratory selection and frozen visual brief before any future Image2 use
Create a new append-only decision before restart-5 or any currently locked stage can resume
